## Summary

Describe the change and the project decision/specification it implements.

## Evidence

- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] Course content validation passes when content changes
- [ ] Relevant experiment/test evidence is attached when behavior changes

## Reproducibility

Document the configuration, commit, dataset/content version, and environment needed to reproduce the result.

## Notes

Call out open questions, limitations, or intentionally deferred work.
